detail.rationale: The root blocker pid 95607 is a batch worker running month-end close that has been idle in transaction for 4 seconds, blocking 1 session and contributing to 12 total sessions waiting on locks. Checkout telemetry shows 4 timeouts in the last 15 seconds (92% success rate, below typical SLO). The workload name 'batch_replayable_month_end_close' strongly suggests this is a replayable batch job that can be safely terminated and restarted. Terminating this blocker will immediately release its locks and unblock the waiting sessions, restoring checkout throughput.
